The HWPX renewal update failed because modified paragraphs retained legacy layout cache elements, violating document integrity requirements.
Execution failed in test_outputs.py::test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache with an AssertionError. The verifier detected that modified paragraphs in section0.xml or section1.xml still contained 'hp:linesegarray' elements. Specifically, the assertion 'assert paragraph.find("hp:linesegarray", NS) is None' failed, indicating that the renewal logic updated text fragments (e.g., customer, owner_name, window) but neglected to strip the stale layout cache from the HWPML XML structure.
